title: Downward categoricity transfer to the Hanf threshold under CH
exact_target: Assume CH. If an abstract elementary class K in a countable finitary relational language has $LS(K)=\aleph _{0}$ and is categorical in a cardinal above $H(K)=beth_{\omega _{2}}$, must it be categorical in H(K), without amalgamation, tameness or joint-embedding assumptions?
